answers.q1: uv (lockfile uv.lock; do not use pip). Install with: uv sync. CI installs with `uv sync --locked --extra all` (lint job) or `uv sync --no-dev --group tests --extra all` (test job). Both CI forms need `--extra all`.
answers.q2: bash scripts/test.sh  (runs: PYTHONPATH=./docs_src pytest -n auto --dist loadgroup tests scripts/tests/). Run it as `uv run bash scripts/test.sh` if the venv isn't activated. CI runs it with coverage: `uv run --no-sync bash scripts/test-cov.sh`.
answers.q4: CI lint is pre-commit, run via prek: `uv sync --locked --extra all && uv run prek run --from-ref origin/<base-branch> --to-ref HEAD --show-diff-on-failure`. To run the same checks locally, use `uv run bash scripts/lint.sh`, which runs `mypy fastapi`, `ty check`, `ruff check fastapi tests docs_src scripts` and `ruff format fastapi tests --check`. Hooks in .pre-commit-config.yaml also run typos, check-yaml/toml, whitespace fixers and zizmor. To auto-format, use `uv run bash scripts/format.sh`.
answers.q5: uv.lock is a generated lockfile; change it with uv commands, not by hand. README.md is generated from docs/en/docs/index.md (`uv run ./scripts/docs.py generate-readme`), so edit index.md instead. The sponsor banner partial docs/en/overrides/partials/banner-sponsors.html is rendered from docs/en/data/sponsors.yml by `scripts/docs.py render-banner-sponsors`. Translated docs under docs/<lang>/ (everything except docs/en/) are managed by the translation tooling (scripts/translate.py, translation_fixer.py), and the `ensure-non-translated` hook guards them, so don't hand-edit them. The docs/en/docs/release-notes.md latest-release date is also added by a hook. No vendored directories were found.
